shot: RA-07 round 6 M1 'Trains at home instead': one take, START to END, same locked camera
intent: The same man as the gym-closed clip (dark hair, short beard, black t-shirt, black shorts, grey running shoes) stands in his bright living room (grey sofa with a knitted throw, framed landscape picture, floor lamp, curtains and window, wooden table, rug), facing the camera, feet planted. START: both arms hang at his sides, a black hex dumbbell in each hand. Motion: his right arm (on the left of the picture) curls its dumbbell up to his shoulder, upper arm staying at his side; his left arm keeps its dumbbell hanging at his side. END: same camera, same feet, legs, hips and room; right forearm vertical with the dumbbell in front of his right shoulder, left arm unchanged; he looks at the curling dumbbell. He does not walk, turn or lean. Nothing in the room moves.
